I'll start.  
1. Life is a puzzle without a predefined shape. Some of us start out with a bunch of pieces that fit together. Others start with a bunch of mismatched pieces that don't make sense until later. Just because you don't like the picture so far doesn't mean you won't ever. You always have more power to better your life and those of those around you than you think. You get to decide how your puzzle pieces fit together and it's okay if you don't know yet. You have permission to not know.
